Swapped our out live lobsters for frozen ones!
Apr 2026 • Family
Absolutely horrible experience.

It should have been a red flag that the place was completely empty, but we went anyway because we specifically wanted Atlantic lobsters. We personally chose four large live lobsters from the tank outside, so expectations were high.

What came out was completely different.

Instead of serving the lobsters whole, they were chopped into small, dry pieces. Very unusual and honestly suspicious. The texture was odd and the taste was not fresh at all. It genuinely felt like the lobsters we chose were swapped out for frozen ones.

For a bill of nearly $600, this was a total waste of money. Very disappointing and frankly sketchy. Would not recommend.

And to think, a good meal is so cheap in Da Nang.
